description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_HostBlacklist that extends HTMLPurifier_URIFilter, implementing an URI filter to block hosts based on a blacklist configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_HostBlacklist
classes.description: A URI filter class that blocks URIs with host parts matching entries in a blacklist.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the blacklist from configuration settings.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Checks if a URI's host matches any blacklisted fragments; blocks it if so.
